duplicate_priority: same company + same job title + same source
same company + same opportunity description + same source
same public professional email + same opportunity
normalization: Compare URLs without insignificant trailing slashes where appropriate.
Treat obvious URL tracking parameters as non-essential when they do not change the underlying page.
important_distinction: The same company can have multiple distinct opportunities. Do not merge separate jobs or projects merely because the company is the same.
duplicate_action: Skip the duplicate opportunity. If the existing record has new useful information, update that existing record instead.
historical_action: Never delete historical leads merely because they became expired, closed, or irrelevant.
